findings.title: Docker socket mounted into service
findings.description: Mounting the Docker socket gives the service full control of the daemon: it can start privileged containers and escape to the host trivially. Use the socket only in dedicated, audited tooling with a read-only proxy.
findings.expected: no Docker socket mount; use a socket proxy if needed
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Docker and CIS Docker Benchmark best practices. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, least privilege, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
